meta.name: Signal Design System — Colors
meta.description: Anti-Slop compliant color palette for Signal
meta.philosophy: Distinctive visuals that stand apart from generic AI outputs

antiSlop.description: Colors explicitly banned from the design system to avoid AI clichés

banned.name: teal-500
banned.reason: Overused in AI products, signals 'generic AI tool'

banned.name: AI purple
banned.reason: The quintessential AI color, screams algorithmic origin

banned.name: violet-500
banned.reason: Variation of AI purple, equally problematic

banned.name: cyan-500
banned.reason: Close cousin of teal, same algorithmic feel

primary.name: orange
primary.description: Warm, energetic, distinctive — the opposite of cold AI blues

accent.name: emerald
accent.description: Natural green, not algorithmic teal — organic and approachable

neutral.name: stone
neutral.description: Warm grays for sophisticated dark mode — not cold zinc or slate

success.name: green
success.description: Standard success green, distinct from accent emerald

warning.name: amber
warning.description: Warm warning color, complements orange primary

info.name: orange
info.description: Uses primary for info to avoid introducing blue
